overview: Put a bed in the loom with a dye and it comes out with a pattern on the blanket, in every pattern the loom offers and as many layers as a banner takes.

1.0.0: Beds go in the loom's banner slot and come out wearing the pattern.
Break a patterned bed and you get the patterned bed back.
Beds standing side by side keep one pattern each.
Server side: Pandorical draws the pattern, so there is nothing extra to install.
